automation_guidance.eq: Compare current mix band shares against eq_band_targets; use ReaEQ for broad static correction only.
automation_guidance.dynamic_eq: Use ReaXcomp/TDR Nova if installed for bands whose current p90 or burstiness exceeds target high range.
automation_guidance.ms_eq: Use mid/side routing or JSFX M/S tools only when side-minus-mid is outside target range. Keep 20-120 Hz mostly mono.
automation_guidance.reverb: Use ambient_tail_proxy only as a rough full-mix clue. Real reverb decisions need vocal/instrument stems.
automation_guidance.saturation: Match density with parallel saturation/soft clipping. Avoid bright drive if overbright_saturation_risk is high.

reaper_recipe.copyright_safety: Technical target matching only; do not copy creative elements.

vocal_chain_when_stem_exists.purpose: HPF 70-100 Hz, body 150-500 Hz shaping, remove resonances only after stem analysis
dynamic 2-5 kHz presence and 5-8 kHz harshness control
glue/dryness repair if vocal sounds detached

instrumental_bus.purpose: 120-350 Hz mud control, preserve 40-120 Hz weight
restore harmonic body without broad gain pushing

mix_bus.purpose: broad dynamic EQ on mud/presence/harsh/air bands
gentle glue only if stems/current comparison proves detachment
soft clip before limiter for density

master_chain.purpose: small broad correction from current-vs-reference band deltas
ceiling -1.0 dBFS, do not chase unsafe reference true peaks
measure WAV and MP3 after encode

ai_high_end_repair.purpose: avoid air boost until hash/fizz score is under control
